The Just Energy Transition must place communities at its core, especially those impacted by the shift from traditional industries like coal.

#Digital technologies, such as smart grids and data platforms like the GeoHub, offer real-time insights into energy access and spatial inequalities. Tools like the Clean Electricity Equity Index (CEEI) guide policymakers in addressing energy justice by pinpointing opportunities in the just energy transition. Meanwhile, digital platforms enable collaborative planning, giving communities a voice in repurposing former coal sites and shaping future investments.
